prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: base A of a single-difference puzzle for a mobile game. Create one landscape 4:3 illustration, no panels, no writing. A luthier's workbench, elegant indigo ink with watercolor washes of copper and muted cobalt, natural wood bench. Viewed from a high oblique angle. About twelve individually readable objects: unfinished violin body left, detached violin neck upper left, bow diagonally across the back, closed varnish pot with brush, two carving tools, curled wood shavings, tuning fork at right, small pliers, three tuning pegs, and a small rectangular wooden wind instrument lying flat in the foreground slightly right of center. This foreground instrument is 28 percent of the whole image width. Its visible long front face has EXACTLY FOUR large evenly spaced dark rectangular air holes, sharply drawn and separated by broad wooden dividers; all four visible, no extra holes elsewhere on this small instrument. Keep other instruments and tools plausible. Rich but orderly composition with clear object boundaries, no microscopic details. The small holes should remain countable when the entire scene is viewed only 175 pixels wide. No people, hands, letters, numerals, watermark, outline marker or puzzle UI.
